csv_scope_of_work: This solicitation is to obtain services in connection with Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) services. The SCA anticipates awarding up to eight (8) contracts to firms that are prequalified by the SCA at the time of contract award. To assist you with your request, the following is a brief summary of services that will be required: The firms selected under this RFP will provide the SCA scope, design, and construction support services on a variety of MEP projects which include, but are not limited to, full building electrification, heating plant upgrades, ventilation systems, climate control systems, electrical systems, fire alarm systems, public address systems, air-conditioning systems, waste systems, sprinkler systems and other capital categories
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering

title: Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing Services
short_description: Framework-style procurement for MEP design and construction support on school capital projects.
project_scope: Up to eight contracts for scope development, design, and construction support for various school MEP projects, including full building electrification, heating plant upgrades, ventilation, climate control, electrical, fire alarm, public address, air-conditioning, waste, and sprinkler systems.
services: MEP services; scope development; design; construction support; disciplines requested include architecture, landscape architecture, civil engineering, electrical engineering, and mechanical engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- The tender is focused on MEP services, which are explicitly not a target area for sbp.
- No bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or structurally demanding building scope is described.
- It appears to be a multi-contract procurement for recurring MEP-related projects rather than a specific structural design opportunity.
- Any civil engineering component is incidental and not the core of the tender.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. The notice describes an on-call/multi-project MEP services procurement with up to eight contracts, but provides no project budgets, building sizes, or quantities that would allow a realistic overall construction cost estimate.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. Because this is a multi-contract MEP services procurement without defined project volumes or budgets, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived.
references_qualifications: Firms must be prequalified by the NYC School Construction Authority at the time of contract award.
contracting_authority: NYC School Construction Authority, Flushing, NY, USA. Contact: Keely Guallpa. Email: kguallpa@nycsca.org. Phone: 718-752-5092. Website: https://a856-cityrecord.nyc.gov/RequestDetail/20260506001
notes: Project No. 26-00117R. The notice states that up to eight contracts may be awarded. Although architecture and civil engineering are listed among requested disciplines, the procurement is clearly centered on MEP services and is therefore not relevant for sbp under the stated criteria.
